svg.title: Time-aware supersession
svg.desc: On a time axis, the relation Ali lives_in Berlin is observed on 2026-03-02 and the relation Ali lives_in Kreuzberg on 2026-04-06. The newer one supersedes the older, which stays stored with status superseded. A plain search returns Kreuzberg; a search with a since/until window returns Berlin marked as superseded; include_superseded returns both.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A newer observation supersedes an older one. The older one is kept.
